objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the built-in Messenger, Mail, and Community work hub into a dense cohesive visually interactive communications suite.

bominal_patterns_reviewed: /tmp/bominal-ref/docs/design-system/README.md Stripe x Palantir flat dense tactical visual language
/tmp/bominal-ref/app-bizos.jsx command center and workflow output route density

gap_analysis.source: current runtime screenshot inspection after the Bominal command-center/evidence repair
findings_addressed: The Work Hub was still sparse compared with Bominal: a simple tab/list/detail/composer layout with too little operational density.
Messenger, Mail, and Community were present but did not yet feel like built-in first-class products connected to Workflow, Action Inbox, Evidence Spine, and Audit.
The surface lacked channel KPIs, communication filters, dense draft/evidence/unread states, and a visible delivery matrix.
Local interactions existed, but did not clearly stage send/publish/evidence workflows while preserving the no-backend constraint.

implemented: Added a communications KPI strip for threads/drafts, workflow routes, evidence links, and external sends.
Expanded Workflow output routes to explicitly show Messenger/Mail/Community fan-out with REC-WF-7741 evidence return paths.
Added All/Unread/Drafts/Evidence filter pills, dense channel rows, per-row status chips, and metadata for unread/evidence/draft/review states.
Added synthetic but cohesive Messenger, Mail, and Community items tied to payroll close, HomeTax, cloud rollback, procurement policy, governance council, and audit evidence.
Upgraded the selected communication detail with route/workflow/receipt/persistence metadata and richer action controls for review, task creation, workflow linking, send preview, and local publishing.
Added a delivery matrix in the right rail showing Messenger, Mail, Community, and Audit readiness as one cohesive product flow.
Updated fallback JavaScript to preserve item kind/meta, filter by communication kind, update status text, queue local drafts, and handle send/publish/evidence actions without backend writes.
Mirrored the denser communication hub in SSR static HTML so the surface is present before hydration and remains visually interactive after hydration.

observations: SSR output contains comms-kpi-strip, comms-delivery-matrix, 4 data-comms-filter controls, and 14 data-comms-kind rows/templates

verification.command: Playwright smoke for #work-hub, Messenger/Mail/Community tabs, filters, search, draft queue, evidence attach, publish preview, console/network health

observations.evidenceStatus: Messenger · 3 visible · evidence filter · local only

verification.command: pixelmatch secondary debug diffs against Bominal corporate, employees, and workflow-studio references cropped to shared 1440x900 viewport

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style built-in communications suite integrated with Workflow, Evidence, Action Inbox, and Audit surfaces
visual_verdict.verdict: The Work Hub now reads as a first-class cohesive product surface rather than a generic tabbed widget. Messenger, Mail, and Community each expose dense rows, route metadata, workflow receipt context, local actions, and delivery readiness while staying visually aligned with the flat tactical Bominal design language.
improved_matches: Communication state is visible through KPIs, filters, chips, and delivery matrix rather than hidden behind a simple composer.
Messenger/Mail/Community now share one workflow/evidence spine and return to the same audit receipt context.
Local actions are visually functional: filters hide rows, tabs switch dense channel lists, drafts queue locally, evidence attach updates status, and publish preview stays local.
SSR and hydrated/fallback interactivity both carry the denser surface.
remaining_differences: No real messaging, mail transport, community backend, workflow execution, or audit write is wired.
The broader full mockup goal still requires continued depth in lower dashboard surfaces and final cross-surface completion audit.

non_claims: No Messenger post, email, community publication, task creation, workflow execution, or evidence write leaves the browser.
All changes are local visual prototype state and static/hydrated UI only.
This advances the complete mockup but does not claim the full objective is finished.
